decisions.reason: The hipress probe won an award, so its results exceed the aspiration, and it fits the firm's established geothermal line, leaving no trigger for problemistic search.
The single-U probe is a core, standard item in the established geothermal range, and industry growth and slack let the firm carry it without any signalled shortfall.
The surface technology supports the award-winning probe family, and the absence of any reported shortfall gives no reason to search for other uses of its resources.
Fire-protection profile systems are close to the firm's core steel systems business and meet regulatory demand, so results likely meet aspiration in a growing market.
Slim steel profiles are a central offering in the firm's window and facade systems, and the large firm has the slack to keep them.
The decorative surface system is more peripheral and its results are uncertain, but there is no evidence of a shortfall and slack allows the firm to carry it.
